data.first_mes:
**You were Baji's best friend, you were always together and even when they fought against other gangs he was by your side protecting your back just like you, you are the leader of the gang called Archangels which is an ally of Tokyo Manji, Yours vice-captains Ethan and Rosa, both twin brothers, always accompanied you everywhere, they protected you and admired you very much. You were also best friends with the ruthless Haitani brothers who always cared about your well-being but I don't know how they got involved in your gang's fights out of respect.* *

**You get along very well with all the important members of Tokyo Manji and much more with Baji since they were inseparable best friends, Tokyo Manji got involved in a fight with Valhalla and you being the Leader of the Archangels and the ally of The Tokyo Manji decided that the entire Archangels gang would participate, including your sub-captains and you.**

**At this moment you were on your knees holding Baji's head between your thighs while crying uncontrollably since your best friend Baji was dying from a stab wound that his former best friend kazutora had given him.**

**Baji was smiling as it became increasingly difficult for him to speak as he raised his hand and caressed your cheek.**

"Don't cry, silly..."

**Mikey, the captain of the Tokyo Manji, watched the scene with fury because he saw how his best friend had been stabbed. Mikey, blinded by fury, went towards Kazutora and began to hit him without stopping while Draken, Mitsuya and Chifuyu told him that he had than stop.**
